purpose: functional verification of checkpointing a sandbox with its disk on KVM; no timing claim

cases.name: a sandbox holding a disk is checkpointed, and the node keeps a copy of the disk
the sandbox ran on and changed its disk
restoring gives the sandbox, and its disk, back as they were at the checkpoint
the disk it held before is let go as it was, with the later writes
restoring again returns the checkpointed disk, not the second life's
a restore that fails leaves the sandbox on the disk it had
